objective: Reconcile prepared Defects4J identities in label-free top-level FREEZE metadata with source/episode directory exclusions before choosing protected confirmation.
scope: Exact private WSL archive root. Only real regular top-level FREEZE.json files up to2MiB; no symlink traversal, provider replies, scores, evaluator labels, source bodies or credential files selected. Project only case_id/project/bug from root identity and cases, completed_public_cells and captures metadata arrays.
caution: Reading JSON freezes parses their bytes, but identity projection accesses no free-form query/source/output/label fields and emits only identities, file hashes and coverage diagnostics. This is not a full archive-content scan or exposure certification.
policy: Canonical Defects4J IDs, known project/positive bug coordinates; conflicts/unknown IDs fail closed as unresolved. Deduplicate arms and repeated freeze identities. Conservatively exclude prepared cases even if no provider dispatch is proven. Freeze-only and directory-only origins remain visible; cross-dataset revision aliases still unresolved.
runnable_frontier: Freeze and test census, then resolve reported other manifest schemas, remote/removed inventory and cross-dataset revision aliases. Do not select by previous outcome or easier source availability.
operational_residue: R7 original campaign continues independently; no source edits, restart, providers or labels in inventory. Publication separate.
open_questions: Which source-only/cohort/input manifests add identities or cross-dataset aliases?
Can removed and external campaign records be conservatively reconciled?
What protected confirmation population survives the completed audit?
